title: Service division divestiture carve-out
prompt:
Daniel needs the Service division carve-out ready for the next investment-committee review.

Use the July corporate-development correspondence, the 7/5 controller-tied IC book, the current data-room export, the diligence review notes, and the approved underwriting policy. Treat the 6/29 banker case as change history only, and resolve conflicts using approval status, dates, document status, and management correspondence.

Rebuild reported segment EBITDA from the twelve-month Service division P&L. Map directly attributable revenue and cost, apply only the shared-service allocations required by the separation memo, add the documented standalone public-company costs, remove intercompany revenue, and exclude buyer-specific synergies. Show the net carve-out adjustments and standalone EBITDA.

Apply the agreed transaction multiple to standalone EBITDA. Deduct the documented debt-like items and stranded-cost remediation to calculate net cash proceeds retained by Alder Ridge.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `reported_segment_ebitda`, `net_carveout_adjustments`, `standalone_ebitda`, `transaction_enterprise_value`, `debt_like_items`, `stranded_costs`, `net_cash_proceeds`. Use dollar amounts to two decimals.
